Published モードで検証する場合は、検証用と明記した別 Agent だけ: To evaluate in Published mode, Publish only a separate Agent clearly labelled for validation. This is distinct from sharing with users after acceptance. Do not change the Agent in use or user permissions. Successful Publish alone does not satisfy Chapter 18's quality requirements.
指示や設定の改善を試すときは、実習で使う Agent を保持し、別の検証用 Ag: When testing improvements to instructions or settings, retain the Agent used for the workshop and compare with a separate validation Agent. See section 16.9 for the differences between the standard track and AI reference configuration. Use the original 10 questions / 84 requirements in this chapter; do not rename or weaken questions or the rubric, and satisfy all applicable requirements with AND. Acceptance and source/data accuracy are separate dimensions. T01 requires the period meaning of "static 2025". T03 also permits the clarification branch; mark only requirements that do not apply to the chosen branch as NA. T04 requires literal `Relationship:` / `Traversal:` lines, and T06 requires the literal sentence `All timestamps are UTC.`. Do not embed held-out questions or expected answers in instructions or examples.
ソース指示（query・期間・粒度）／schema（要素の意味）: Source instructions (query, period, grain) / schema (element meaning)
raw 観測と保存済み MV の bucket を区別。一意性の拒否より先に許可: Distinguish underlying raw observations from stored MV buckets. Obtain observation totals with an allowed scalar SUM before refusing to prove uniqueness; do not substitute a GROUP BY detail sample.
静的 2025 と UTC scope を明示し、根拠のない JST 日付フィル: State the static 2025 and UTC scope explicitly; do not invent a JST date filter. Do not quote a combined total across different grains, even in a negative statement.
誤ルート・ラベル欠落・危険な推論: Wrong route, missing labels, or unsafe inference
実ルートと必須の関係・UTC 技術ラベルを確認し、ラベルは翻訳しない。個人に関す: Verify the actual route and required relationship/UTC technical labels; do not translate the labels. Do not permit personal inference or safety bypasses.
モデルの欠落・意味の曖昧さ: Missing model elements or ambiguous meaning
物理データ／Ontology／接続済み semantic model: Physical data / Ontology / connected semantic model
実体の table/view、型・key・binding・関係方向を照合してから: Check the actual table/view, types, keys, bindings and relationship directions before changing only the necessary layer. Adjusting an unconnected Optional semantic model is not evidence of a Core improvement.
症状・設定層・証跡の対応（質問・期待値は再掲しない）: Symptoms, configuration layers, and evidence (without repeating questions or expected values)
比較する構成を決める。使用中の Agent の設定・定義を非公開で保存し、許可さ: Select the configurations to compare. Privately save the settings and definition of the Agent in use, then create a separate, clearly named validation Agent in an authorized Folder. Check Code Interpreter, runtime, example queries, source bindings and selected elements. Do not change the Agent in use or the shared Ontology. Do not add unselected EventID or raw tables.
変更範囲を決める。基線・変更する層・変更しない項目・評価回数を先に固定する。必要: Define the change scope. Fix the baseline, changed layer, unchanged fields and number of evaluation runs first. Identify required sources and output fields before querying; do not mark an answer complete until actual execution evidence is available. Global instructions govern source ownership, UTC headers, reconciliation keys and refusal; source instructions govern queries, periods and grain. Use deterministic query examples only when appropriate for a supported source. Do not judge instructions by brevity alone; record metadata changes separately when comparing them too.
UI で 1 問ずつ実行する。対象 Agent・Draft / Publishe: Run one question at a time in the UI. Before starting, verify the target Agent, Draft / Published mode, runtime and source selections. For every question, verify completed Clear chat confirmation and a fresh conversation; a click alone is insufficient. Read back the entire Unicode input and verify an exact match to the original question before Send. Submit exactly 1 question per conversation and record all queries, all returned results, analysis steps and the complete final answer.
固定 10 問を 1 バッチとして採点する。エラー・途切れた応答も原本を残す。回: Grade the fixed 10 questions as 1 batch. Preserve original errors and truncated responses too. Do not edit answers into a pass or treat execution errors as appropriate refusals. After the batch, check that instructions, runtime, source selections and bindings still match the starting configuration. If the configuration changes, rerun all 10 questions rather than performing only a partial retest.
利用者に共有する前に反復と未見セットで評価する。確率的な 1 回の 10/10: Evaluate repeated runs and an unseen set before sharing with users. One stochastic 10/10 run is not a guarantee. Once an unseen question informs a repair, treat subsequent runs as regressions, not first-use evaluations. Freeze additional unseen questions and criteria before the next instruction change. Proceed to the sharing procedure in Chapter 18 only with configurations that satisfy the original strict criteria, are verified as non-regressing, and are approved.
予定していない設定変更、選択要素の追加、参照先の変更、または証跡の欠落を見つけた: Stop evaluation if you find an unplanned configuration change, added selection, changed connection or missing evidence. Recheck the configuration in the actual UI, resolve the cause and then reevaluate against the original conditions. Do not adjust questions, required evidence or the scope of NA to fit results.
構成と証跡を確認できなければ停止: Stop if configuration and evidence cannot be verified
